ipc.title: IPC-D-356 netlist exported by kicad-cli 10.0.6 from the KiCad import of icicle_kit_rev_1p0_20-0532_pcb_0624_01.brd
ipc.licence_note: Net names per pad; derived data, see docs/PLAN.md section 3.5. Net names are truncated to their last 14 characters and refdes to 6 by the IPC-D-356 format

default_rule: default = the GitHub embedded-software user guide setting (the jumpers needed to boot Linux); ug_pdf_default keeps the UG PDF Table 2-1 column for the honesty card. J9 follows the twin's embedded-programmer default; J47 and J21 come from the UG.
conflict: The UG PDF lists J15/J17/J24/J28/J34/J35/J43/J45 as 'Short pin 1-2'. For J34/J35/J43 the netlist shows 1-2 selects 3.3 V, so the PDF column contradicts the HSS 1.8 V default and the GitHub guide.

netlist_checks.conclusion: 2-3 gives Bank 4 1.8 V: matches the GitHub guide and the HSS 1.8 V MMC default
2-3 gives VDDAUX4 2.5 V: matches the GitHub guide
2-3 ties the mux supply to Bank 4 VDDI: matches the GitHub guide
cannot be confirmed from net names; GitHub 2-3 = 1.05 V is used (unverified)
UG text (5 V for the USB3340 VBUS switch) matches the nets; the GitHub text calls it USB mode selection
